issuing_body: King, on the advice of the National Legislative Assembly
title_english: Energy Industry Act B.E. 2550 (2007)
notes: Given 9 Dec B.E. 2550; published Government Gazette Vol. 124 Part 89 Kor on 10 Dec 2007; in force the next day (s.2). Sets up the ERC; s.47 licensing with Royal Decree exemptions; s.81 network access codes (basis for TPA). No enacted amendment found; amendment proposals exist. Source is the ADB-hosted unofficial English translation.

issuing_body: King (Royal Decree under s.47 Energy Industry Act)
title_english: Royal Decree prescribing energy industry operations exempt from licensing B.E. 2552 (2009)
notes: Secondary source only: reportedly exempts generation under 1,000 kVA from the ERC licence (notification to the ERC still required); 2010 clarification for off-grid in-plant systems. Exact Thai title, date and later amendments not confirmed; check the Royal Gazette.

title_english: Thailand Power Development Plan 2018-2037 (PDP2018)
notes: Approved at NEPC meeting 1/2562 on 24 Jan 2019 (EPPO resolutions portal). Cabinet approval reported in May 2019 (date not confirmed). About 56 GW of new capacity, 77,211 MW total by 2037.

title_english: Thailand Power Development Plan 2018-2037, Revision 1 (PDP2018 Rev.1)
notes: Considered at NEPC meeting 1/2563 (150) on 19 Mar 2020; IEA says published 2020. Still the plan in effect (Chambers 2026). Draft PDP2024 (hearing June 2024) was never adopted; draft PDP2026 (2026-2050) went to hearing on 8 Sep 2026 and is not yet approved. Later Cabinet step not confirmed.

title_english: Alternative Energy Development Plan 2018-2037 (AEDP2018)
notes: Listed as a draft for consideration at NEPC 1/2563 (150) on 19 Mar 2020, alongside PDP2018 Rev.1, EEP2018 and Gas Plan 2018. Approval outcome and current status to be checked in the resolution PDF.

title_english: NEPC resolution on guidelines for promoting rooftop solar generation
notes: Title confirmed on the EPPO portal only. IEEFA (2026) says the household buy-back rate rose from THB 1.68 (2019 'Solar for Thai People' net billing) to THB 2.20/kWh in 2021; that this resolution made the change is likely but unconfirmed. The 2019 scheme itself still needs a row (ERC regulation, title not confirmed).

title_english: NEPC resolution on the electricity tariff structure policy of Thailand 2021-2025
notes: Title confirmed on the EPPO portal. Policy period ended 2025; succeeded by the 2026-2030 policy (NEPC 15 Jul 2026). The ERC sets actual tariffs under it.

title_english: NEPC resolution on feed-in tariff rates for renewable power 2022-2030
notes: Sets FiT (THB/kWh): biogas (wastewater/waste) 2.0724; ground-mounted solar 2.1679; solar + BESS 2.8331; wind 3.1014; +0.50 in southern border provinces. Revised principles at NEPC 7/2565 on 7 Nov 2022 (not a separate row yet).

title_english: NEPC resolution postponing the retirement of Mae Moh lignite units 8-11
notes: Title confirmed on the EPPO portal. The Nation reports the postponement to 31 Dec 2025 amid high LNG prices. Superseded for units 8 and 11 by NEPC 21 Aug 2025.

title_english: ERC Regulation on procurement of renewable electricity under the FiT scheme 2022-2030 for the group without fuel costs B.E. 2565 (2022)
notes: 27 Sep 2022 is the Government Gazette date (signing date not confirmed). Up to 5,203 MW (biogas 335, wind 1,500, ground solar 2,368, solar+BESS 1,000 per Baker McKenzie). First round: 175 projects, about 4,852 MW (2023).

title_english: NEPC resolution on guidelines for setting the Utility Green Tariff (UGT)
notes: Date on both the EPPO portal and the ERC slide deck hosted by BOI (30 Jul 2024). Two products: UGT1 (no specified source) and UGT2 (specified sources).

title_english: NEPC resolution on additional renewable procurement (no-fuel-cost group and industrial waste) under FiT 2022-2030
notes: 3,668.5 MW second round (Thai press: about 2,632 MW solar, 1,000 MW wind, 6.5 MW biogas, 130 MW industrial waste). Shortlist 16 Dec 2024; NEPC deferred procurement on 25 Dec 2024; resumed with negotiations on 6 May 2025. The ERC regulation for this round (B.E. 2567) has no row yet: title and date not confirmed.

title_english: ERC approval of the Utility Green Tariff 1 (UGT1) rate
notes: ERC deck dates UGT criteria to Jan 2024 and UGT1 rate approval to Feb 2024. UGT1 launched Jan 2025 at THB 4.21/kWh, one-year contracts with EGAT/MEA/PEA (Reccessary, 24 Jan 2025). The 2026 UGT1 premium was revised (Argus: Bt0.0375/kWh proposed), so status may be 'amended'. No document number found.

title_english: NEPC resolution on measures allowing private parties to sign direct power purchase agreements (Direct PPA)
notes: Pilot for data centres via third-party access (TPA), up to 2,000 MW. ERC drafts (Direct PPA Regulation and TPA Code) published 3 Oct 2025; not confirmed final. Cap lifted and scope widened by NEPC 15 Jul 2026.

issuing_body: Ministry of Industry (Department of Industrial Works)
title_english: Ministerial Regulation on the designation of types, kinds and sizes of factories (No. 3) B.E. 2567 (2024)
notes: Effective 28 Dec 2024 (Tilleke); signing date not confirmed. Rooftop and building-mounted solar no longer a 'factory' at any size (before: factory licence above 1 MW). ERC licences or exemptions still apply. Base regulation it amends not confirmed.

short_name: Cabinet carbon price in fuel excise
title_english: Cabinet resolution approving a draft Ministry of Finance ministerial regulation embedding a carbon price in excise tax on oil products
notes: THB 200/tCO2e on gasoline, diesel, kerosene, jet fuel, LPG and fuel oil, built into existing excise rates (no pump price change). The ministerial regulation's gazette date and effective date not confirmed; it needs its own row once found (Excise Department / Royal Gazette).

title_english: NEPC resolution on the remaining additional renewable procurement under the 2023-2030 clean power plan
notes: Directed ERC, EGAT, PEA, MEA and EPPO to start negotiations with selected applicants after the 25 Dec 2024 deferral. Follow-up resolutions on 21 Aug and 27 Oct 2025 (EPPO portal) not yet rows.

title_english: ERC Notification (No. 2) B.E. 2568 revising the PPA timeline for the 2024 additional FiT round (no-fuel-cost group)
notes: Moves the PPA signing deadline for SCOD-2026 projects to 29 Jul 2025. It amends a 2024 ERC notification that has no row yet. Exact date not confirmed (before 29 Jul 2025).

title_english: NEPC resolution revoking the earlier resolution to split the system operator from EGAT into a separate legal entity
notes: System operator stays in EGAT, ring-fenced. Meeting date is 21 Aug 2025 on the EPPO portal; Pattaya Mail says 23 Aug. The earlier resolution it reverses is not yet identified.

title_english: NEPC resolution on managing Mae Moh power plant, replacing units 8-9
notes: Units 8 and 11 run to 2031 instead of end-2025; units 12-13 refurbished and run to 2048. Units 9-10 reportedly restarted in March 2026 (GEM wiki, unconfirmed).

title_english: NEPC resolution on the Community-based Solar Power Generation Project
notes: 1,500 MW, up to 10 MW per site as VSPP, sold to MEA/PEA. Further NEPC/EPAC resolutions on 28 Nov 2025, 15 Jul 2026 and 3 Aug 2026 (EPPO portal) may change its terms.

short_name: Data centres as EGAT direct customers
title_english: NEPC resolution on amending the Royal Decree so that data centres can be direct customers of EGAT
notes: Title confirmed on the EPPO portal only; effect and any resulting Royal Decree not confirmed. Same meeting: guidelines for IPS (self-generation and private-to-private supply), a captive-power item not yet a row.

title_english: Cabinet resolution approving in principle the draft Climate Change Act B.E. ...
notes: The Act itself is NOT enacted. Council of State review was under way in May 2026 (205 sections, 14 chapters). The bill provides for a carbon tax, GHG reporting and a Climate Fund (Chambers also mentions an ETS). House dissolved 12 Dec 2025; post-election status not confirmed.

issuing_body: King (Royal Decree under the Revenue Code)
title_english: Royal Decree issued under the Revenue Code on tax exemption (No. 805) B.E. 2569 (2026): rooftop solar deduction
notes: Personal income tax deduction up to THB 200,000 for on-grid home solar up to 10 kW; published 2 Mar 2026, runs to 31 Dec 2028. Signing date not confirmed; exact English title is our rendering.

title_english: NEPC resolution on promoting rooftop solar for households
notes: Net billing at THB 2.20/kWh, 10-year contracts, 500 MW national quota (up from 90 MW), 5 kW per meter, households only. Needs an ERC implementing notification (IEEFA, Aug 2026: still pending); MEA/PEA installer registration ran 3 Aug-30 Sep 2026. Same meeting revised residential tariff policy.

title_english: EPAC resolution on the Utility Green Tariff 2 (UGT2, source-specific) rate
notes: Title confirmed on the EPPO portal. Chambers says an ERC resolution made the UGT2 tariff effective from 1 May 2026, with applications expected late 2026 and service from 2027; dates conflict and the rate is not confirmed (2024 drafts were about THB 4.55-4.56/kWh). The ERC tariff decision may need its own row.

title_english: NEPC resolution on criteria for the pilot Direct PPA for renewable power through third-party access (TPA)
notes: Opens Direct PPA beyond data centres to industry and removes the 2,000 MW cap (The Nation); EPAC is the selecting and supervising body; EPAC approved principles 3 Aug 2026; ERC consultation followed. Same meeting: grid-use security deposits for data centres. Final ERC Direct PPA regulation and TPA Code not confirmed as issued.

title_english: NEPC resolution on the electricity tariff structure policy of Thailand 2026-2030
notes: JETRO: separate cost-reflective data-centre tariff; first 200 kWh for homes at THB 3; Direct PPA buyers and data centres may pay into the Power Development Fund. Eco-Business reports data centres expected to pay about THB 5-6/kWh.

title_english: ERC Regulation on procurement of electricity from community-based solar power generation projects B.E. 2569 (2026)
notes: Gazette 22 Sep 2026, in force 23 Sep 2026 (law-firm summaries; PDF blocked 403 from here). Up to 1,500 MW, 10 MW per project, 25-year non-firm PPA with MEA/PEA at THB 2.1679/kWh; foreign shareholding at most 49%. English title is our rendering; check the Thai title.
